New York's Diamond District: Georgia's AG charged 11 in a retail-theft ring hitting two Signet chains.

Kay Jewelers and Zales were among ten retailers targeted across Georgia, Florida, South Carolina and Virginia. Prosecutors say the group stole Rolex watches and gold jewelry, reselling it on Instagram.

"Organized retail crime poses a significant threat to our state," AG Chris Carr said.

New York's diamond trade lost its only independent sustainability certification this month.

SCS Global retired its SCS-007 standard 1 September, saying "the market conditions needed to support the voluntary standard at scale have not materialized." Miners never adopted it, and no replacement exists.

Jewelers who built sustainability claims on the certificate are left without a formal way to prove them.
